slot_scores.name: ending_backorders_zero
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether all backorders must be cleared by the end of June or whether demand must be fully satisfied by the planning horizon. The READY_TO_MODEL summary even allows B_t ≥ 0 for all t and includes June backorder cost, with no terminal zero-backorder condition.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Backorders may remain positive at the end of June; there is no terminal requirement that ending backorders be zero.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about or confirmed a terminal backorder-clearing condition, but the READY_TO_MODEL summary lists only B_t ≥ 0 for all t and does not impose B_6 = 0.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot H1 remained unresolved: it never clarified whether all backorders must be cleared by the end of June.

summary: The agent asked many useful clarification questions and resolved most operational details, but it missed the terminal backorder-clearing condition and then silently assumed backorders could remain positive at the end of June.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
